The implementation in .loop/amend.sh only matches the literal regex `git[[:space:]]+diff[[:space:]]+(--[a-zA-Z-]+[[:space:]]+)*HEAD(...)` — it has no branch for `git log` or `git rev-list`, unlike rule 4's own gate_diff_refs()/grep -oE 'git...(diff|log|rev-list)' in run.sh (lines 348-349), which this new check does not mirror. A task whose verify uses `git log HEAD -- docs | ...` or `git rev-list HEAD -- docs | ...` without either environment variable would misfire exactly the way this task exists to catch, and amend.sh check would say nothing — while the doc it ships tells a future plan-writing session it would.

findings: SKILL.md's new paragraph claims the advisory fires on a verify that diffs against HEAD via `git diff`/`log`/`rev-list`, but amend.sh's regex only matches `git diff ... HEAD` — a `git log HEAD` or `git rev-list HEAD` scope guard missing the two task-identity variables gets no advisory at all, silently reproducing the exact false-reversion failure mode this task exists to warn plan authors about. Either narrow the doc to 'git diff' or broaden the regex to match diff|log|rev-list as rule 4's own gate_diff_refs()/grep pattern in run.sh does.
notes: Mechanics (regex, advisory-not-fatal shape, scenario, doc-count bumps, offline suite) are all solid and match the acceptance criteria's literal (git-diff-only) examples.
